hero.title: Street-level view of the urban village
hero.caption: The character stands in a generated alley between tiled residences, window cages and air-conditioning units.

combat-interaction.title: Combat interaction
combat-interaction.caption: In-game combat demo: approach, melee exchanges, hit reactions and knockdown.

skill-vfx.title: Spin attack
skill-vfx.caption: At normal speed, the silver crescents turn outward with the blade. Dust lingers at the character’s feet as the trail fades.

skill-displacement.title: Displacement attack
skill-displacement.caption: A sprint leads into the displacement attack. The curved flashes and dust mark successive positions along the path of travel.

combat-contact.title: Close-range hit feedback
combat-contact.caption: A close-range strike and hit feedback in the combat test scene.

gasp-block.title: Katana guard movement
gasp-block.caption: The character moves and changes facing while holding a katana in guard.

melee-r22-trace.title: Server trace replay
melee-r22-trace.caption: Separate server trace, slowed down. The black blade turns 230.1° in 116.6 ms. Its path changes from grey to orange when the attack window opens at 22.8 ms. At 46.7 ms the red marker shows where the blade met the teal collider. Times are relative to the first pose.

melee-r22-pie.title: Melee collision from above
melee-r22-pie.caption: Unreal recording at normal speed. Dark teal shows the previous blade pose and cyan the next. Orange traces the active sweep. The first swing registered contact 9.35 ms into its sample interval. The second registered contact 2.80 ms into its own interval.

cr-facing.title: High sphere
cr-facing.caption: The character locks onto the high sphere and plays the three-cut combo. The sphere flashes red when the blade makes contact.
cr-facing.hint: High target in the saved melee test facility

cr-low.title: Low sphere
cr-low.caption: The same combo starts at the same horizontal distance from the low sphere. Each red flash is the test target’s own contact feedback.
cr-low.hint: Low target in the saved melee test facility

material-sphere.title: Material studies
material-sphere.caption: Material-instance controls demonstrated on a wall preview: surface variation, coverage and texture rotation.

glass-transmission.title: Glass transmission
glass-transmission.caption: Glass surface study in the test scene: a character remains visible through the tinted panel.

glass-variants.title: Glass surface variants
glass-variants.caption: Side-by-side glass panels show different tint and surface treatments under the same scene lighting.

wall-weathering.title: Tiled wall weathering
wall-weathering.caption: A tiled facade with surface variation and accumulated weathering along its lower edge.

material-instance-controls.title: Surface variation parameters
material-instance-controls.caption: Material-instance editor with displacement, color variation, coverage masks and opacity controls beside the rendered wall preview.

occlusion-walkthrough.title: Building occlusion walkthrough

occlusion.title: Camera & occlusion
occlusion.caption: In-game walkthrough: walls and floors reveal the character moving through the building and stairwell.

pcg-urban-village.title: Procedural building height
pcg-urban-village.caption: Unreal Editor capture: changing building height updates the floor stack, windows and rooftop structure.

pcg-dimensions.title: Building dimensions
pcg-dimensions.caption: Unreal Editor capture: interactive building-size changes update the modular envelope and facade. Full-length GIF from the supplied recording.

building-study.title: Modular building study
building-study.caption: Blender asset-generation preview: fixed window modules and a complete building envelope. This is an asset study, not an in-engine screenshot.

module-kit.title: Modular building components
module-kit.caption: Python / Blender tooling: installed frontage, window accessories and modular construction details.

pcg-variants.title: Building variants

pcg-graph.title: Building generation graph
pcg-graph.caption: City Village PCG graph: parcel input, building controls, mesh spawning, and layout, manifest and diagnostic outputs.

commercial-plan.title: Commercial street plan
commercial-plan.caption: Street selection in the Python planner. The Unreal walkthrough below uses a separate district.

guilin-overview.title: Guilin foundation, regional view
guilin-overview.caption: Regional views across 8.064 km. Rows are seeds 185, 741 and 2026. Each row doubles relief from 15% (left) to 30% (right).

guilin-local.title: Guilin foundation, local view
guilin-local.caption: Closer views of the same three seeds and the same 15% versus 30% relief settings.

large-river.title: Large River spline edit

lightning-growth.title: Seed 4 branch growth
lightning-growth.caption: Follow the first forks and the progressively finer branches in three views of seed 4. Offline geometry playback.

lightning-pie.title: Niagara discharge
lightning-pie.caption: Watch the faint upper leader during branching. The main channel stays connected to its source, then brightens along its length at contact. Fixed endpoints, seed 4, normal-speed Unreal playback.

river-bank.title: Bank after the spline edit
river-bank.caption: The same edited bend at bank scale, after the new shoreline and adjacent slope have been published.

terrain-chuanxi-mountains.caption: Western Sichuan · mixed mountain terrain. Retained mixed-terrain baseline. Elevation range 2,584 m across 8.064 km. Seed 185.

terrain-chuanxi-plateau.caption: Western Sichuan · rolling plateau. Accepted plateau layer. Elevation range 2,584 m across 8.064 km. Seed 185.

terrain-chuanxi-shoulders.caption: Western Sichuan · broad ridge shoulders. Preferred ridge-shoulder study. Elevation range 2,584 m across 8.064 km. Seed 185.

terrain-chuanxi-rock.caption: Western Sichuan · rocky slopes. Retained slope study. Elevation range 2,584 m across 8.064 km. Seed 185.

terrain-chuanxi-valley.caption: Western Sichuan · broad valley. Valley study under review. Elevation range 2,584 m across 8.064 km. Seed 185.

group-settings.title: Group administration
group-settings.caption: The group owner can rename the club, change its visibility and joining policy, or invite friends.

notifications.title: Comment notifications
notifications.caption: Mina and Theo commented on a film Alex added. Both replies appear in Alex’s notification feed.

group-selection.title: Group selection & joining
group-selection.caption: The demo account belongs to two groups. Each row shows its invitation code, nickname field, and group entry button.

movie-detail.title: Movie details, votes & discussion
movie-detail.caption: The detail page for In the Mood for Love shows its ratings, group votes, and options for moving or sharing the film.

desktop.title: Friday Night on desktop
desktop.caption: The public English sign-in page at fridaynight.love, captured on a desktop viewport.

mobile.title: Friday Night on mobile
mobile.caption: The same public sign-in page at a 390 px mobile viewport.

group-workflow.title: Shared movie list
group-workflow.caption: The English watchlist shows each film’s poster, synopsis, ratings, votes, and comment count.

watch-together.title: Watching together in the living room
watch-together.caption: Alex and Mina share a sofa while the TV plays a locally cached excerpt of Big Buck Bunny (Blender Foundation). Recorded with two demo accounts.

dvd-shelf.title: Opening a DVD case
dvd-shelf.caption: In the Mood for Love slides off the shelf. The case opens to show the sleeve and disc.

theater-desktop.title: Browsing the desktop filmstrip
theater-desktop.caption: Scroll the filmstrip beside the projector preview, then select a title.

theater-mobile.title: The projector on a small screen
theater-mobile.caption: Expand the projector, fold it away, then scroll to Her and open its film card. Recorded at a mobile viewport size.

courtyard.title: Chinese courtyard
courtyard.caption: A player outside the courtyard pavilion in daylight.

cinema.title: Inside the cinema
cinema.caption: A view from the projection booth toward the rows of seats and the screen.

hero.title: WayJia spacecraft and dialogue
hero.caption: Final-game press-kit screenshot: a spacecraft, a black hole and a conversation in deep space.

exploration.title: Spacecraft exploration
exploration.caption: Final-game press-kit screenshot: spacecraft movement and narrative exploration.

credits.title: Game credits
credits.caption: Final-game credits. Weihan Chen: engineer / programmer and game producer, with design and sound contributions. Art, writing, voices and music include contributions from the wider team and collaborators.

gameplay.title: WayJia gameplay
gameplay.caption: Gameplay capture: spacecraft flight, star interactions, dialogue and transitions between regions.

examples.title: Avatar crop examples
examples.caption: The model blocked a QR referral ad and allowed a historical travel poster. The public image masks the QR code and account name.

chat-answer.title: Eastbank chat reply
chat-answer.caption: The Chat tab shows the exercise question, the frozen test reply and its dated source link. The source and model response come from the project’s test fixtures.

chat-activity.title: Response activity
chat-activity.caption: The activity drawer shows two available bulletins, response planning and citation validation. The displayed timings belong to this local fixture run.

source-check.title: Two passages supporting a shelter report
source-check.caption: The one-time lookup displays the two independent exercise reports behind the 09:00 opening claim. Each quote is checked against its source document.
source-check.hint: Two passages supporting a shelter report

watch-area.title: Confirming a watch area
watch-area.caption: The user reviews the Atlanta exercise location, its 25 km radius and city coverage before saving.

revisions.title: Two revisions of a simulated flood alert
revisions.caption: The latest notice says the alert was lifted. Its expanded timeline keeps both simulated updates for the same event.
revisions.hint: Two revisions of a simulated flood alert

route-start.title: Wheelchair route request
route-start.caption: The evacuation form accepts a device location, a place search or a map pin. The selected travel mode is wheelchair.

route-map.title: Screened detour on the map
route-map.caption: The blue line shows the second route returned by the routing fixture after the first intersected the exercise closure. The base map is OpenStreetMap.

route-result.title: Shelter distance, travel time and route steps
route-result.caption: The card separates straight-line distance from the length and travel time supplied for the schematic detour. It also states which closure reports were checked.
route-result.hint: Shelter distance, travel time and route steps

preferences.title: Saved evacuation preferences
preferences.caption: Travel mode and directions language can be set before a future search. The application stores the preferences on this device.

device-push.title: Background delivery status
device-push.caption: A saved area still receives in-app updates. This instance has no push service configured, which the device panel reports.

preparation.title: General preparation panel
preparation.caption: Notifications includes an expandable, static reference for official updates, essentials and local help. It can be read without sending a chat message.

interface.title: Disaster Chatbot interface
interface.caption: Actual Django interface showing the two revisions of a fictional flood exercise. Matching and timeline storage use the application; the local test fixture supplies the model response.

delivery.title: Notification delivery benchmark
delivery.caption: Measured local simulation. Public version checks and private timeline delivery have different endpoints.

subscription.title: A subscribed location receives a flood update
subscription.caption: A fresh local session confirms an Atlanta watch area, receives an exercise flood report and its update, then opens the supporting passages. The model response is a test fixture.
